evaluation_policy.all_gold_pii: All annotated PII; any unmatched prediction anywhere is FP.
evaluation_policy.personaguard_supported_gold_only: Unsupported gold labels are excluded from FN only.
evaluation_policy.synthetic_injected_region_only: Primary PersonaGuard-v1 metric. Scores annotated synthetic PII and unmatched predictions before seed_prompt; detections inside the original seed context are reported separately and are not counted as injected-region FP.

notes: Primary dataset metric is synthetic_injected_region_only; strict full-prompt metrics remain for safety auditing.
